The view looks toward the south/west corner; it does not reveal the north stair edge or the Bedroom 5 vestibule behind the camera.
Magenta model-home outdoor cushions remain visible through glass, unlike neutral current terrace staging. A minor adjoining-view furnishing cleanup is desirable; this is not an opening error.
Same photographed south/west corner from a modestly shifted companion camera. The French doors, two flank windows, bar recess/window and west slider remain coherent with PL1 and the original.
Companion view, not a reverse view of the stair/bedroom-entry side. Do not describe it as proof of the whole penthouse circulation.
Minor magenta outdoor source upholstery remains visible through glazing and could be coordinated with the selected neutral terrace furniture.
Camera, furniture, bar, tray and door/window geometry remain aligned with PL1 day.

Both small windows flanking the French doors retain dark exposed lower glazing strips under only partly lowered shades. This conflicts with the current manifest claim that all applicable privacy layers are fully closed.
Repair only these two shade drops/opacity; preserve every opening, lamp, tray and furnishing. The original tray permits the shown cove lighting; it is not an invented ceiling form.

A cropped finish view cannot resolve this orientation. Replace with a genuine plan-derived reverse/diagonal view, keeping the west headboard and east pair opposite; north dresser/linen-entry route and south closet must stay on their respective sides.

correctionJobsProposed.prompt: Create a corrected alternate camera of this SAME proposed Bedroom 5 using source photo plus builder penthouse plan. Preserve neutral Mineral & Walnut: mushroom walls, thin painted headboard frame, charcoal upholstered bed, ivory bedding, black lamps, walnut bedside/dresser, natural oak and separate oatmeal rug, flat 9-ft ceiling. The plan is oriented top WEST, right NORTH, bottom EAST, left SOUTH. Headboard stays on WEST wall shared with loft TV, and bed extends toward TWO separated EAST windows directly OPPOSITE. Current reverse wrongly puts the headboard on a wall perpendicular to windows; repair that 90-degree rotation. Place camera near west/south closet-side corner looking diagonally east/north over the bed toward the east window pair. The west headboard is behind/left of the camera, not against the image-right/north wall. North dresser/offset entry/linen route stay north; closet remains south. Show an intelligible section of bed and the east window pair with blank central wall, plus north-side storage/entry if camera permits. Do not invent a third window, sloped ceiling, beam, door in the headboard center or giant room. Ivory sheers with open blackout layers at the two actual/planned windows. Match source furniture and keep the room compact; unbuilt concept, not measured construction.

galleryFloorCoverageDescriptionProposed: Explore the penthouse lounge, proposed new Bedroom5, compact guest bath and rooftop living/dining/sun terraces. Lounge and terrace views use the model-home camera and visible shell; Bedroom5 is unbuilt and follows the builder plan. Bath4 is plan-led. The lounge companion cameras do not show the stair/bedroom-entry side, and the optional exterior spiral must be confirmed at the actual house. All dimensions are builder references pending field measurements.
fieldMeasurementCaveat: This audit checks visible architectural relationships and source consistency, not fabrication dimensions, construction approval, window operability, egress, electrical/plumbing routing or fixture clearances. Use measured plans, actual opening inventory and coordinated shop/installation drawings before ordering/building. No new structural recess or roof enlargement is authorized.
